ideas.title: Investigation into Minnesota Governor and Minneapolis Mayor
ideas.description: This story would investigate the details of the DOJ investigation into Minnesota Governor Tim Walz and Minneapolis Mayor Jacob Frey.
ideas.angle: The specific investigative angle would be to examine the allegations of obstruction and potential wrongdoing by the two officials.
questions: What are the specific allegations against Governor Walz and Mayor Frey?
What are the potential consequences for the two officials?
ideas.insight: As an investigator, I believe this story matters because it has the potential to reveal wrongdoing by high-ranking officials and impact public trust in government.
